records.question: 订单明细一共有多少行?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM order_items;

records.question: 数据库里一共有多少个客户?
records.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_name) AS distinct_name
FROM customers;

records.question: 2014 年一共下了多少张订单?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_cnt FROM orders WHERE strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2014';

records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?
records.sql:
SELECT c.country AS country, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2014-%' AND oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;

records.question: 三个商品大类各自的销售额和总利润是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT p.category AS category,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items AS i
JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY total_sales DESC

records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(i.sales),2) AS sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_cnt
FROM order_items i
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;

records.question: 各市场的总利润分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT g.market AS market, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit, COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON c.country = g.country AND c.region = g.region

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql: SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt, COUNT(*) AS item_cnt FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014' AND oi.sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter;

records.question: 2013 和 2014 两年各自的总销售额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) AS year, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales),2) AS total_sales, COUNT(oi.row_id) AS detail_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2013-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, SUM(oi.sales) AS total_sales, SUM(oi.profit) AS total_profit, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) * 100.0 / SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS profit_margin_pct, COUNT(*) AS item_rows FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL AND oi.sales > 0 GROUP BY p.sub_category ORDER BY profit_margin_pct DESC

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?

records.question: Corporate 客户在 2014 年下了多少张订单,平均每张订单金额是多少?
records.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_cnt, ROUND(AVG(t.amt), 2) AS avg_order_amount, ROUND(SUM(t.amt), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(sales) AS amt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t ON t.order_id = o.order_id WHERE c.segment = 'Corporate' AND o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH valid_sales AS (
  SELECT sales FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM valid_sales
), ranked AS (
  SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn FROM valid_sales
)
SELECT (SELECT c FROM stats) AS cnt,
       ROUND(AVG(ranked.sales), 4) AS median_sales
FROM ranked, stats
WHERE ranked.rn IN ((stats.c + 1) / 2, (stats.c + 2) / 2)

records.question: 2015 年 7 月到 12 月的总销售额是多少?

FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的市场是哪个?

records.question: Technology 大类 2014 年的总销售额是多少?

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。
records.sql: SELECT p.sub_category, ROUND(AVG(oi.profit),2) AS avg_profit, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE oi.profit IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.sub_category HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0 ORDER BY avg_profit;

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit),2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC;
